description: Settings of the statistical comparison of detectors, the counting-accuracy check and the CPU latency benchmark for the YOLO yellow-flower benchmark.
model: metric ~ detector (fixed) + (1 | fold) (random intercept), REML; detector effect tested with the randomized-complete-block F test (df 4, 16), which equals the Kenward-Roger F test of the mixed model for this balanced design; likelihood-ratio test on ML fits as a check
variance_partition: two-way additive ANOVA sums of squares (detector, fold, residual) and method-of-moments variance components (equal to REML for a balanced design, truncated at zero)
pairwise: all 10 detector pairs; differences paired by fold; SE from the residual mean square (df 16); Tukey-adjusted 95% CIs for difference tests

equivalence.method: two one-sided tests (TOST) using the pooled residual SE (df 16); equivalence declared when the 90% CI lies within (-delta, +delta); joint equivalence of a set of detectors by the intersection-union principle (every pair equivalent)

sensitivity.cv_dependence_correction: Nadeau-Bengio corrected paired t: variance of the mean difference = (1/k + n_val/n_train) * s_d^2, with n_val/n_train the mean ratio of validation to training tiles over folds (df 4)
sensitivity.leave_one_fold_out: refit after dropping each fold in turn; report detector p-value, fold and detector variance shares, TOST outcomes

count_accuracy.models: saved YOLOv9t fold models (BENCH_ALL.zip fold*/weights/best.pt), each applied to its own held-out fold
count_accuracy.inference: imgsz 640, CPU, per-tile NMS IoU 0.7 (framework default) followed by NMS IoU 0.5 as in the wall-to-wall mapping
confidence_thresholds: F1-optimal from the fold's own validation (reported only, not used to tune the map)
count_accuracy.matching: greedy one-to-one matching by descending confidence at IoU >= 0.5
count_accuracy.outputs: TP, FP, FN, precision, recall, F1, predicted/reference count ratio per fold and pooled

latency.models: architectures built from the framework configuration files with one class (weights do not affect forward-pass cost)
latency.protocol: CPU, batch 1, 640 x 640 input, fused model, float32, 2 threads, 30 warm-up passes, 200 timed passes, median and IQR of forward-pass time
latency.flops: GFLOPs reported by the framework for a 640 x 640 input
